title: Jugs' Portraits
description: Decorative portraits from the OnlyJugs community.
body:
## About
Jugs' Portraits adds portrait frames to the game which can be used to display portraits that the player owns in the OnlyJugs community.

## Gameplay
Craft and place custom frames. Right-clicking on them will open up a GUI showing all the portraits that you own on onlyjugs.net - If you don't see any you either simply don't own any, or haven't linked your UUID yet. Even without, you can still see other people's portraits.

## Features
- Custom portraits to decorate your world with
- Unique images with custom wear that are all unique
- Collect and show off your most precious collection
